run.prompt: Draw an animated SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. Make the wheels turn and the pelican pedal. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
run.notes: SVG authored directly via show_widget inline rendering tool — no external generation script, no Python, no headless Chrome probe. Four CSS @keyframes animations: wheelSpin (1.2s linear infinite) rotates both wheel groups with 8 spokes each about their hub centers; pedalCrank (1.2s linear infinite) rotates crank arms + pedals as a group about bottom bracket; legPedal (1.2s ease-in-out infinite, right leg -0.6s phase offset) oscillates each leg to track pedals; bodyBob (0.6s ease-in-out) bobs pelican body vertically. All animations disabled via prefers-reduced-motion media query. Bicycle frame is geometric line-art (blue stroke, 5px). Pelican: white body ellipse with coral stroke, blue wing with feather detail, curved neck via thick stroke overlay, orange beak with hook tip and pink pouch with detail lines, crest feathers on crown. Legs are stroked paths (amber fill, brown outline) ending in elliptical feet on pedals. Wing-to-handlebar connection shown as dashed hint line. Chain is dashed ellipse. Motion lines at rear suggest forward movement. Known defects recorded rather than corrected: chain is a static dashed ellipse not linked to gear geometry; legs are 2D screen-plane paths without IK solving so pedal tracking is approximate (visual only); hips fixed (no seat-post reaction); saddle occluded by body; no audio; one syntax error in source (#888780 missing quote in chainring circle stroke attribute). Poster derived by stripping all <style> block and animation class attributes, leaving static rest-pose first frame.
